typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		{T D} as string,
		{S D} as string,
		LoB as string,
		Ticker as string,
		{1099} as string,
		{B S} as string,
		Shares as string,
		{Reference Price} as string,
		{ACT confirmation} as string,
		Comment as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(LoadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		TD as string,
		SD as string,
		BS as string,
		Comment as string,
		Ticker as string,
		Load_Date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ACTconfirmation as string,
		Shares as string,
		ReferencePrice as string,
		LoB as string,
		YN_1099 as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		TD = {T D},
		SD = {S D},
		BS = {B S},
		Comment,
		Ticker,
		Load_Date = LoadDate,
		ACTconfirmation = {ACT confirmation},
		Shares,
		ReferencePrice = {Reference Price},
		LoB,
		YN_1099 = {1099}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
